output_text: Python error handling: Validate inputs early, before expensive operations; validate all inputs at API boundaries before any processing begins. Report all validation errors at once when possible. Parse external data into typed domain objects at boundaries; use Pydantic for structured validation. Use specific exception types with context; explain what failed, why, and how to fix it. Chain exceptions with `raise ... from e` to preserve the debug trail. In batch operations, don't let one failure abort everything. Never let one bad item abort an entire batch. Track successes and failures separately. Provide progress visibility without coupling business logic to UI. Document failure modes, log contextual IDs/counts, and test err
